title: Quenched Indian Christmas Pudding Vindaloo
description: A yeasty, snappy vindaloo that marries the sweet depth of Christmas pudding with the fiery spice of Udupi cuisine, served in a kadhai for a Mediterranean-friendly twist.
instructions: Heat the oil in a kadhai over medium heat.
Add the minced garlic and grated ginger and sauté until fragrant.
Add the sliced onion and cook until translucent.
Stir in the tomato puree and brown sugar, cooking for 3 minutes.
Add the vindaloo spice paste and mix well.
Pour in the diced Christmas pudding and chopped nuka-pickle, tossing to coat with the sauce.
Add the cooked chickpeas and stir to combine.
Season with salt and bring the mixture to a gentle simmer.
Cover and let cook for 20 minutes, stirring occasionally.
Garnish with chopped coriander before serving.
Note: this recipe is for refrigerator pickling/preserving only — store in the refrigerator and consume within 1 week. Do not water-bath can without an acid (vinegar or lemon juice).
